newsitem.title: USA: Ford offers direct stock purchases for new investors.
newsitem.headline: Ford offers direct stock purchases for new investors.

text.p: Ford Motor Co. said Wednesday it has established a stock purchase programme that allows new investors to buy their first shares directly from the automaker for an initial $1,000.
Subsequent purchases of Ford stock require a minimum of $50, under the first direct stock purchase plan by a North American automaker.
Unlike some other similar programmes, investors are not required to own Ford stock before participating, it added.

The plan allows an investor to make additional periodic purchases through automatic bank withdrawals, set up an individual retirement account that invests in Ford common stock, take out a loan or set up a line of credit that is backed by Ford stock, and make transactions by telephone.

Dividends may be reinvested in full or in part in Ford stock or paid in cash. Investors may also buy stock in whole dollar amounts rather than a specified number of shares. There is no charge for stock transfers or gifts, Ford said.

Investors new to Ford may arrange for automatic deductions of at least $100 from a bank account for at least 10 consecutive purchases. Once the $1,000 minimum purchase commitment is met, additional investments may be made for as little as $50, it added.
The plan will be fully effective on June 2 and is offered and administered by First Chicago Trust Co. of New York.
Ford's stock slipped 37.5 cents to $35.375 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
